scopeBasis: Provided chapter plan, textbook sections and teacher deck. The original course scope is preserved through the listed lessons.
officialCodeStatus: Not independently verified against a retrievable current official outcome register. No outcome codes have been invented. Confirm code-level mapping during division/Codex acceptance.

lessons.title: Fertilization and the zygote
lessons.learningGoal: Explain where fertilization normally occurs, how one sperm contributes its chromosomes, and how the diploid chromosome number is restored.

lessons.title: Cleavage, morula, blastocyst and implantation
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish cleavage, morula, blastocyst and implantation, and connect each stage with its location and cell organization.

lessons.title: hCG and maintaining early pregnancy
lessons.learningGoal: Trace hCG through the corpus luteum to progesterone and the endometrium, and explain the later placental contribution.

lessons.title: Gastrulation and the three germ layers
lessons.learningGoal: Describe gastrulation and connect ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm with representative tissues.

lessons.title: Extraembryonic membranes and support structures
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish amnion, chorion, yolk sac, allantois and umbilical cord, using their positions and functions.

lessons.title: Organogenesis and neurulation
lessons.learningGoal: Explain differentiation, morphogenesis, organogenesis and neural-tube formation without equating early structure with mature function.

lessons.title: The placenta and exchange
lessons.learningGoal: Trace placental exchange and umbilical blood flow, and explain why the placenta is neither a complete barrier nor a site of normal bulk blood mixing.

lessons.title: Fetal development and developmental influences
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish embryonic and fetal development, identify the age convention used, and explain how timing, dose and susceptibility affect developmental outcomes.

lessons.title: Labour and birth as positive feedback
lessons.learningGoal: Trace cervical stretch, neural signalling and oxytocin, then distinguish the three stages of parturition.

lessons.title: Lactation and hormonal control after birth
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish prolactin-driven milk production from oxytocin-driven milk ejection and connect both with suckling and post-birth hormone changes.

lessons.title: Reproductive technologies and informed decisions
lessons.learningGoal: Compare the physiological or mechanical action of reproductive technologies and identify what evidence can and cannot establish.
